'''Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Topaz)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 29 to cast. It enchants 10 [[topaz bolts]] into [[topaz bolts (e)]] or 10 [[topaz dragon bolts]] into 10 [[topaz dragon bolts (e)]]. The enchantment gives the ''Down to Earth'' effect. This gives the bolt a chance of lowering the opponent's [[Magic]] level, but only works on other players.
